cases.objective: The app shell starts on the phone and the bottom navigation opens the Workout tab and returns Home
cases.input: Controlled test user "Device Tester" (in memory); tap "Workout", then "Home"
cases.expected: Home shows "TODAY'S WORKOUT"; Workout tab shows "Your workout plan"; Home shown again
cases.actual: Home shown (greeting "Device" 1); Workout tab "Your workout plan" 1; returned Home
cases.test: ATC-DEV-S01 The app shell starts on the phone and the bottom navigation opens the Workout tab and returns Home

cases.objective: The Workout tab shows the weekly plan generated for the profile
cases.input: Test user: healthy, 6 training days a week; open the Workout tab
cases.expected: "Your workout plan", "<intensity> intensity · 6 days a week", 7 day buttons of which 1 is a rest day
cases.actual: Summary "Moderate intensity · 6 days a week" shown 1; day buttons 7; rest-day buttons 1
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M4-01 The Workout tab shows the weekly plan generated for the profile

cases.objective: Selecting a workout day shows that day's session and its exercise count
cases.input: Workout tab; tap the first training day that is not already selected
cases.expected: Header "<day name> · <focus>" and an "Exercises" count equal to the day's main exercises
cases.actual: Monday: header "Full-Body Fitness · Total body" shown 1; 9 planned entries (5 main); exercise cards on screen 9
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M4-02 Selecting a workout day shows that day's session and its exercise count

cases.objective: An exercise opens its detail screen with the planned sets, reps or time and rest, and Back returns to the plan
cases.input: Workout tab; tap the first exercise card; then Back
cases.expected: Exercise Detail shows the exercise name and the planned dose; the plan is shown again after Back
cases.actual: "Dynamic Warm-Up" 1 sets × 180 s, rest 0 s: name 1, sets 1, reps/time 0, rest 1; back on the plan
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M4-03 An exercise opens its detail screen with the planned sets, reps or time and rest, and Back returns to the plan

cases.objective: Regenerate plan produces a different exercise selection (cloud save unavailable in the test session)
cases.input: Workout tab; "Regenerate plan" → confirm "Regenerate"
cases.expected: The weekly plan changes; the app reports that the new plan could not be saved to the server (no account in the test)
cases.actual: Plan changed: true; message "New plan generated, but it could not be saved to the server."
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M4-04 Regenerate plan produces a different exercise selection (cloud save unavailable in the test session)

cases.objective: The training profile card names the profile of the health classification
cases.input: Test user with "Hypertension"; Workout tab
cases.expected: "Your training profile: <category>" for the classifier's category
cases.actual: Category At-Risk; card "Your training profile: At-Risk" shown 1
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M4-05 The training profile card names the profile of the health classification

cases.objective: A reported warning symptom blocks plan generation and the reason is shown (negative case)
cases.input: Test user; readiness answer: chest pain; Workout tab
cases.expected: "A doctor's clearance comes first" and rule SCR-SYMPTOMS; no exercise cards
cases.actual: Gate shown; rule SCR-SYMPTOMS shown 1; exercise cards 0
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M4-06 A reported warning symptom blocks plan generation and the reason is shown (negative case)

cases.objective: Without a health profile (no classification) no plan is invented (negative case)
cases.input: Test session with no profile; Workout tab
cases.expected: "Complete your health profile to get a personalised workout plan."
cases.actual: Empty-state message shown 1; plan null
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M4-07 Without a health profile (no classification) no plan is invented (negative case)

cases.objective: Posture check opens Posture Detection with Today's workout, My plan and the Exercise library
cases.input: Home → menu → "Posture check"
cases.expected: Tabs "Today's workout", "My plan", "Exercise library"
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the menu button
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-01 Posture check opens Posture Detection with Today's workout, My plan and the Exercise library

cases.objective: Today's workout lists today's plan entries (or the rest day) from the personalised plan
cases.input: Posture Detection → "Today's workout"
cases.expected: One entry per exercise of today's plan day, or the rest-day message when today is a rest day
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the menu button
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-02 Today's workout lists today's plan entries (or the rest day) from the personalised plan

cases.objective: My plan shows every day of the complete plan with each entry's camera capability
cases.input: Posture Detection → "My plan" → each training day
cases.expected: For every training day: its entries with a capability label
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the menu button
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-03 My plan shows every day of the complete plan with each entry's camera capability

cases.objective: The generic Exercise library keeps its camera and manual sections
cases.input: Posture Detection → "Exercise library"
cases.expected: "Camera posture detection" and "Manual guidance" sections
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the menu button
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-04 The generic Exercise library keeps its camera and manual sections

cases.objective: A planned camera exercise opens mode selection; Continue without consent does not start the camera
cases.input: My plan → a camera-tracked planned exercise → Continue with the consent toggle off
cases.expected: Both modes and the consent switch; the consent message; no camera screen
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the menu button
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-05 A planned camera exercise opens mode selection; Continue without consent does not start the camera

cases.objective: With consent the real camera session starts on the phone, and Stop Session ends it with a summary
cases.input: Planned camera exercise → consent on → Continue → about 8 s of live camera → "Stop Session"
cases.expected: Live camera overlay running, exercise name or setup hint, privacy notice; after Stop: "Session Summary" whose reps equal the session counter; saved in memory only
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the menu button
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-06 With consent the real camera session starts on the phone, and Stop Session ends it with a summary

cases.objective: Manual Guidance shows the set counter, checklist and controls, and Pause stops the clock
cases.input: Planned exercise → Manual Guidance → Continue → Pause → Resume
cases.expected: "Manual Guidance", "Proper Form", "Completed ✓", "Skip", "Too Difficult"; Pause switches to "Resume" and back
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the menu button
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-07 Manual Guidance shows the set counter, checklist and controls, and Pause stops the clock

cases.objective: A refused camera permission keeps the camera off and offers Manual Guidance (denial simulated in the app, no system dialog)
cases.input: Camera permission answer "denied" (AppPermissions override); consent on → Continue → "Use Manual Guidance"
cases.expected: "Camera access needed" dialog; no camera screen; Manual Guidance opens
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the menu button
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-08 A refused camera permission keeps the camera off and offers Manual Guidance (denial simulated in the app, no system dialog)

cases.objective: An exercise the camera cannot follow says why and still offers Manual Guidance
cases.input: Exercise library → first exercise in "Manual guidance" section
cases.expected: Mode selection explains that camera detection is not available, with the reason; Manual Guidance available
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the menu button
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M5-09 An exercise the camera cannot follow says why and still offers Manual Guidance

cases.objective: The chatbot's mic opens the Module 6 voice assistant, which shows the state matching the phone's microphone permission
cases.input: Home → AI chatbot (Module 13) → "Voice assistant"; microphone permission as set on the phone
cases.expected: Voice assistant screen (not the chatbot); granted → "Listening..."; not granted → "Voice input unavailable" with the reason and "Try again"
cases.actual: Phone microphone permission: denied; assistant state: unavailable; reason shown 1; "Try again" 1; chatbot still on top: 0
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M6-01 The chatbot's mic opens the Module 6 voice assistant, which shows the state matching the phone's microphone permission

cases.objective: A quick-action chip is answered from the real session state and spoken with the phone's text-to-speech
cases.input: No active workout; tap the chip "How many reps?"
cases.expected: Reply card says there is no active workout session (no invented numbers); text-to-speech reports no failure; at most 3 chips
cases.actual: Reply: "There's no active workout session right now. Open an exercise and tap Start Exercise to begin."; engine On-device rules (Dialogflow unavailable); speech output failed false; chips 2
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M6-02 A quick-action chip is answered from the real session state and spoken with the phone's text-to-speech

cases.objective: "What's my workout today?" is answered from the personalised plan
cases.input: Test user's plan; tap the chip "What's my workout today?"
cases.expected: Reply names today's plan day, or says today is a rest day, matching the plan
cases.actual: Plan today: rest day; reply "Today is a rest day in your plan. Light walking or stretching is fine if you feel like moving."
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M6-03 "What's my workout today?" is answered from the personalised plan

cases.objective: The close button leaves the voice assistant and the app stays usable
cases.input: Home → chatbot → voice assistant → "Close voice assistant" → Back
cases.expected: Voice assistant closed; chatbot shown; Back returns to Home
cases.actual: Voice assistant closed; chatbot shown 1; Home shown after Back
cases.test: ATC-DEV-M6-04 The close button leaves the voice assistant and the app stays usable

cases.objective: Home → plan → exercise → Manual Guidance session → summary → the planned exercise is done today (Modules 4 → 5 → 4)
cases.input: Test user with a workout today; Workout tab → today's quickest repetition exercise → Start exercise → Manual Guidance → "Completed ✓" for every set (rest timers run) → Finish → Back to Workout Plan → Posture check → Today's workout
cases.expected: Summary "Confirmed N reps" with N = sets × reps; session saved with its plan link and target reached; the entry is marked "done today"
cases.actual: Error: No tested frequency gives a workout on weekday 6
cases.test: ATC-DEV-INT-01 Home → plan → exercise → Manual Guidance session → summary → the planned exercise is done today (Modules 4 → 5 → 4)

cases.objective: During a live camera session the voice assistant answers from that session and the session continues (Modules 5 ↔ 6)
cases.input: Planned camera exercise → consent → Continue → menu "Ask Baymax (voice)" → chip "How many reps?" → close
cases.expected: Reply states the camera counter's reps for that exercise; after closing, the camera session is still active
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the menu button
cases.test: ATC-DEV-INT-02 During a live camera session the voice assistant answers from that session and the session continues (Modules 5 ↔ 6)

cases.objective: The voice chip "Pause workout" pauses the running posture session (Module 6 → 5)
cases.input: Planned exercise → Manual Guidance → "Ask Baymax" → chip "How many reps?" → chip "Pause workout" → close
cases.expected: Session paused; the guidance screen shows "Resume"
cases.actual: Error: Timed out after 20 s waiting for the menu button
cases.test: ATC-DEV-INT-03 The voice chip "Pause workout" pauses the running posture session (Module 6 → 5)
